Strategic QA Consulting
Build a QA Strategy That Supports Business Growth
Quality assurance should be more than a final testing activity. It should be built into the way software is planned, developed, released and improved.Market Cloud’s Strategic QA Consulting helps organisations assess their current testing maturity, identify quality gaps and define a practical QA strategy aligned with business priorities, technology environments and delivery goals.Our consultants work across people, processes, tools and governance to create a fit-for-purpose quality model that improves consistency, reduces inefficiencies and strengthens release confidence.
Our Services
QA Maturity Assessment
Evaluate your current testing processes, governance, capabilities, tools and delivery practices to identify strengths, gaps and improvement opportunities.
Strategic Test Planning
Define a clear testing strategy aligned with business objectives, application risk, delivery models and quality expectations.
QA Governance & Standards
Establish practical quality standards, ownership models, reporting structures and decision frameworks to improve consistency across teams.
Test Process Optimisation
Streamline existing QA workflows to reduce duplication, improve efficiency and support faster, more predictable releases.
QA Operating Model
Design the right structure for roles, responsibilities, engagement models and collaboration between QA, development and business teams.
Skills & Capability Development
Identify testing skill gaps and define the capabilities, training or specialist support required to strengthen internal QA teams.
Tool & Automation Advisory
Assess current testing tools and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions based on real requirements, integration needs and long-term value.
Continuous Quality Improvement
Create an improvement roadmap with measurable priorities to help QA capability evolve alongside business and technology change.
